_meta.description: Sample negotiation transcript demonstrating a Successful Agreement with concessions respecting all constraints. Manually authored reference example, not an automated Gemini output.

agents.primaryGoal: Obtain a competitive price while maintaining required product quality and delivery standards.
constraints: Must not exceed total purchasing budget ($110,000 USD)
Must not agree to unit price above $100 USD/unit
Must not accept quality below Grade 3

agents.primaryGoal: Secure a profitable sale while maintaining an acceptable commercial margin.
constraints: Unit price must stay above supply cost ($65 USD/unit)

turns.message: We would like to place an order for 1,000 units at an opening price of $82 per unit with Net-60 payment terms and delivery in 21 days.
turns.decision_explanation: Opening move seeking to anchor near the low end of the feasible zone while remaining within the $110,000 budget and satisfying our delivery window.

turns.message: Thank you for the opening proposal. $82 is below our target commercial margin. We can commit to 1,000 Grade 4 units at $96 per unit with standard Net-30 terms and fast 14-day delivery.
turns.decision_explanation: Rejected $82 as yielding an inadequate margin over $65 cost. Countered with $96 offering expedited 14-day delivery to justify the premium.

turns.message: We appreciate the fast turnaround offer, but $96 stretches our allocation. We can move our price up to $88 per unit and adjust payment terms to Net-45 if you can meet us on an 18-day schedule.
turns.decision_explanation: Made a $6 concession towards vendor's position and compromised on payment terms to demonstrate collaborative intent.

turns.message: We value this partnership. We can accept the 18-day delivery schedule and lower our unit price to $92, provided we keep payment terms at Net-30 to manage our working capital.
turns.decision_explanation: Conceded $4 from previous counteroffer ($96 -> $92) and agreed to 18-day delivery while holding Net-30 terms for cash flow security.

turns.message: If we agree to your Net-30 payment condition, can we split the difference and close the contract at $90 per unit for the 1,000 units?
turns.decision_explanation: Proposed a midpoint settlement at $90/unit. Total expenditure $90,000 is well below the $110,000 budget cap and within the $100 ceiling.

turns.message: We have an agreement. At $90 per unit with Net-30 terms and 18-day delivery, this deal meets our profitability thresholds. We confirm acceptance.
turns.decision_explanation: Evaluated that $90 >= $80 floor and provides a healthy $25/unit gross margin above $65 cost. Accepted proposal.

turns.message: Agreement confirmed in Round 3. All buyer constraints (budget <= $110k, price <= $100, lead time <= 30d) and vendor constraints (price >= $80, lead time >= 14d) fully satisfied.
